Method of Attack: Insider threat stealing vulnerability reports submitted through the HackerOne bug bounty platform and disclosing them to affected customers to claim financial rewards
Creating a sockpuppet account on HackerOne to submit duplicate vulnerability reports for bounties
Using off-platform communication channels to disclose vulnerabilities
Using threatening and intimidating language to coerce customers
Indicators of Compromise: Duplicate vulnerability reports submitted by user handle 'rzlr'
Sockpuppet account created by the rogue employee
Access logs showing unauthorized access to vulnerability disclosures
Remote forensics imaging and analysis of suspect’s computer
